_note: Optional pins, hand-entered, US dollars per million tokens, keyed by the canonical model spec a run records (<provider>/<model>; a bare claude-<id> key is read as anthropic/<id>). Nothing requires an entry: a cost comes from the provider if it reports one, else a pin here, else (once built) a market quote from OpenRouter for a model with an alias, else it is null, which is a normal state. Entries are estimates from published list prices (cache write at 1.25x and cache read at 0.1x of input where not stated), are not refreshed automatically and may be stale. A model with a price but no cache rates is priced at the input rate for cached tokens.
